title: Pennies for Poppies
text: The Antelope Valley California Poppy Reserve, west of Lancaster, grew out of the work of a self-taught artist named Jane S. Pinheiro, who recognized that rapid development threatened the poppy fields. Schoolchildren across California helped by collecting Pennies for Poppies. The reserve was established in 1976. It protects about 1,800 acres.
